text.description_html:
Acorn WT4BD, Warwick Dummy Handleset

The Warwick Dummy Handleset is made to be used as a pull on the inactive side of double doors to match the existing trim. Perfect for restoration projects, its features a "S" shaped grip off set by lovely mounts that look as if they have been inspired by nature. The old world design is exemplified in iron from which it is made. The rough black iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of natural weathered iron.

Dummy Handleset: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching:
Warwick Single Cylinder Lockset
Warwick Double Cylinder Lockset

Features of the Warwick Dummy Lockset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Package Includes: Interior and exterior handle, dummy thumbturn, dummy cylinder, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WT4BD Old World Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Length: 10-3/4"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Width: 2-3/4"

Sold Individually
